dataStructure: string (e.g., 'Binary Tree' | 'Directed Graph' | '2D Grid Matrix' | 'Elevation Map' | 'Interval Skyline')
topology: string (explicit root, parent-child links, directed edges u->v with weights, or matrix dimensions M x N)
elements: string (all exact integers, node labels, or coordinate values without approximation)
visualHighlights: string (visual features: shaded water regions, highlighted path arrows, node colors, state transitions, or 'None')
denseSummary: string (dense 40-80 word factual description for text-only downstream solvers)
